terms.definition: The object returns to its original shape and length when the forces are removed.
The increase in length of a spring from its original length.
The extension of an elastic object is directly proportional to the force applied, provided the limit of proportionality is not exceeded: F = k e.
terms.examiner: k is the spring constant in N/m.

terms.definition: The point beyond which extension is no longer proportional to force.
terms.examiner: The force–extension graph stops being straight.
